title: Celebration
paragraphs: “Heroes, thank you for preparing this gathering.”
“No, no, don’t hold back. Everyone should just enjoy themselves.”
“Yes.”
They’re a rather reserved bunch. Or should I say, serious?
“Once we return to the village, we should assess the extent of the damage.”
“If the Queen of Melromarc and Lady Seaetto lend their strength, the restoration should proceed faster than expected. The issue is manpower.”
“It’s also important to consider how long we’ll have to keep fighting the Waves. Our numbers have dwindled, but we need to increase them…”
“We should also select those capable of fighting to assist the heroes. How should we go about that selection?”

While eating, they were repeatedly reflecting on Father’s words and discussing what to do once they returned to the village. Hmm… they’re truly admirable for working so hard for Father. They should keep up that spirit.
“I ordered as usual since Imiya-chan said it was fine, but are there any traditional dishes?”
Mole nodded in response to Father’s question. Now that I think about it, they used to eat some unique dishes back in the village.
“Y-Yes, we do, but it’s fine. Everyone seems to be enjoying themselves.”
“That’s good, but… it looks more like a meeting with food than a celebration…”
Indeed. The only ones praising me are Yuki-chan and a few considerate moles.
“I’ll liven things up! Who wants to have a drinking contest?”
“Sadeena-san took this opportunity to start drinking… Well, as long as she’s making it lively, I guess it’s fine.”

As Older Sister started drinking with gusto, the mercenaries and adventurers in the tavern cheered her on. That energy was contagious, and gradually, the serious atmosphere among the moles shifted to a more cheerful and lively one.
“Alright, alright! Let’s do some introductions and… play a little game! The loser has to reveal who they’re interested in!”

Father, not to be outdone by Older Sister, was doing his best to keep the mood lively. What kind of game is this? As I was wondering that, it seemed to be a high-and-low dice game. Whoever failed to guess correctly until the end would have to do a penalty game. It seems he really did manage events before.

Back in the day, when I participated in group dates, there were always people trying to liven things up like this. Though many disliked it, these things tend to get people excited. Especially when alcohol is involved, the atmosphere heats up even more.

Apparently, the idea of making the loser reveal who they’re interested in came from Father, who inferred it from the moles’ conversations. Since their numbers had dwindled after the attacks on the settlement, they needed to… increase their population through marriage between species or something like that.

Aren’t they all related? That thought crossed my mind, but the moles seemed to understand the situation to some extent. Besides, many of them had met their kin during their time as slaves, so it apparently wasn’t much of an issue.
“Whoa! I lost!”
Even though the mole who lost was embarrassed, they didn’t seem to mind.
“The one I like is—”
And so, confessions happened, leaving the other party blushing. Could it be… a couple was born?
“Oh my! Naofumi-chan’s side looks like they’re having so much fun! I won’t lose either!”
“Sadeena-san, you’re just drinking!”
Naofumi pointed it out, but Older Sister didn’t stop. No matter how much she drank, she just wouldn’t stop. Though not as much as Father, she seemed to be incredibly strong when it came to alcohol.
“Oh my? You’re not eating much. Is there something you don’t like? Should I eat it for you?”
Older Sister, while drinking, approached the younger moles and gently spoke to them to ease their tension. The lively and joyful meal… passed by in an instant.

The meal lasted about an hour and a half, and the moles seemed satisfied. When Ren and Éclair came to pick them up, everyone had cheerful expressions, and the younger ones looked as if they were about to cry, sensing that it was time to leave.
“Is it already over? Will we… be made to suffer again?”
Father and Older Sister gently smiled at the young mole, comforting them as if they were their parents.
“I’m really happy if you enjoyed it. But about that question earlier… it’s not the end. This is just the beginning… I guess?”
“That’s right. Just like Naofumi-chan said, things will get even more fun starting tomorrow. You’re all free now, aren’t you?”

Father and Older Sister gently reassured them, and Mole took the young one’s hand, signaling that everything would be okay. The young mole, who was on the verge of being crushed by anxiety, looked relieved.
“Alright, we’ll be moving now. Everyone, please follow Sword Hero Ren Amaki and Lady Eclair, the daughter of the lord, without worry.”
“Understood. We will do our best from now on to respond to the heroes’ kindness shown at this welcome feast.”
The blacksmith mole, acting as their representative, bowed to Father before turning to Ren and Éclair to bow again.
“See you, Naofumi. I’m leaving the recruitment of the panda to you.”

“You’re asking for something unreasonable this late at night… That person seems to like cute things, so maybe I’ll dress up Sakura-chan or Gaelion and take them along? We made good progress last night, so all that’s left is to slip in some ribbons or something.”
“Nano! If Naofumi asks, Gaelion will do his best, nano!”
“Hm?”
“Well, after that—”
At that moment, one of the moles who had been with us raised their hand.
“I… um, I’d like to help.”
“Yeah, Imiya-chan might be a good choice too.”

Mole had been dressed up in various outfits by Father with great care. Just like with Sakura-chan and the others, he had been doting on them. That panda was overly sensitive to Keel, but it was all because of the outfits that I and Father had prepared. In that sense, things should go well.
“Alright then, Imiya. Do your best to be of help to the heroes. I’m rooting for you.”
“Yes!”
And with that, the blacksmith mole and Mole finished their conversation.
“Alright, we’re heading to Melromarc. Naofumi, or Motoyasu, whichever—send us with the portal.”
Ren’s portal was currently on cooldown.
“Got it. Portal Shield.”
And with that, Ren, Éclair, and the moles were teleported to Melromarc.
“Alright then.”
Father straightened his back and glanced at Older Sister before speaking to Mole.
“I’m not sure if Gaelion-chan and Sakura-chan can stop that person, so Imiya-chan, when I give the signal, pretend to yawn like you’re sleepy, okay?”
“Y-Yes!”
Father subtly directed his gaze toward Older Sister while making the request to Mole. Indeed, Mole seemed well-suited for such a task.
“Motoyasu-kun, are you coming too?”
“I have to check on Yuki-chan’s condition, I say.”
Yuki-chan had a race coming up. Considering the breeder’s advice, I needed to make sure Yuki-chan could rest early to perform her best.
“Got it. Well… I don’t know how things will turn out, but we made some progress today. Motoyasu-kun, do your best too.”
“Yes, indeed!”
“Is Gaelion going with the Shield Hero?”
“Nano! Big Sis needs to go to bed now.”
Of all things, Rival was waving his hand to put Assistant to sleep. Assistant looked a little conflicted. Father had a similar expression.
“No, no, we can’t just leave Wyndia-chan out. But… I guess sleep is important too… hmm.”
Father looked troubled.
“In that case, Father, I’ll come to pick them up in place of Sakura-chan and the others.”

In other words, what Father was concerned about was the health of Sakura-chan and the others. He didn’t want them staying up too late. But without Sakura-chan and the others, it would be difficult to establish a connection with the panda.
